name: Whisper Service
description: Local Whisper transcription service. Headless backend that boots two sibling Docker containers (faster-whisper-server + litellm) and exposes /api/transcribe, /api/clean, /api/status, /api/config. UI lives in com.aura.whisper.config.

provides.name: transcribe
provides.description: POST multipart audio → text. Forwards to the faster-whisper sibling.

provides.name: config
provides.description: Read/write the service's model + prompt configuration.

provides.name: status
provides.description: Readiness of the whisper + litellm sibling containers.
